description: This file defines the custom exception class 'XBRLMappingInvalidException' used within the 'org.apache.fineract.mix.exception' package, extending a platform domain rule exception class to represent invalid XBRL mapping errors.

classes.name: XBRLMappingInvalidException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that an XBRL mapping is invalid, extending the platform's domain rule exception class.
